### Garb of the Planeswalker

This panoply is associated with those who travel between the planes, harnessing magic from across the multiverse.

**Associated Implements:** Cloak (Abjuration), Compass (Conjuration), Eyeglass (Divination)

**Resonant Power:** Each time the occultist invests mental focus into all of the associated implements, the panoply grants the following resonant power. The panoply’s bearer gains the benefit of this power until the occultist refreshes his focus.

*Planar Companion:* You gain an eidolon as an unchained summoner of your occultist level. The eidolon does not gain evolution points normally, but gains 1 evolution point for every 2 total points of mental focus invested in the associated implements.

**Base Focus Power** All occultists who learn to use this panoply gain the following focus power:

*Planeswalker’s Ward:* By expending a point of mental focus as a standard action, you may touch a creature and affect them as per the planar adaptation spell, using your occultist level as your cast level.

**Focus Powers** In addition to the base focus power, occultists who learn to use this panoply can select the following focus powers when choosing powers gained from their focus powers class feature.

- **Cast from the Realm:** By taking a standard action and expending 1 point of mental focus, you may banish a creature as per the dismissal spell (DC 10 + ½ your occultist level + your Intelligence modifier). By expending an additional point of mental focus, you may affect numerous creatures as per the banishment spell using the same DC. You must be at least 7th level to select this focus power.
- **Planar Negotiator:** As a standard action, you may spend 1 point of mental focus gain a bonus on Charisma-based checks made to influence outsiders equal to half your occultist level for 10 minutes. In addition, starting at 9th level, you may spend 1 point of mental focus to cast lesser planar binding as a spell-like ability. At 13th level, this improves to planar binding, and at 17th level this improves to greater planar binding.
- **Wanderer of Realms:** By taking a standard action and expending 1 point of mental focus, you may cast plane shift as spell-like ability. This ability may only be used on willing creatures. By expending an additional point of mental focus, you may automatically show up within 5 miles of your location. Starting at 17th level, you may expend 3 points of mental focus to use gate instead of plane shift, although you may only use this gate for the planar travel function. You must be at least 9th level to select this focus power.
